# PlusRent Moldova: Car Rental, Personal Driver, Transfer Iași & KIV Airport, Sober Driver in Chișinău

> PlusRent (plusrent.md), Chișinău, Moldova, since 2022: car rental, personal driver, Chișinău-Iași and KIV airport transfers, sober driver. 24/7, pay at the end. +373 60 000 500.

**Full machine-readable reference (all prices, FAQ in EN/RU/RO, routes, legal facts):** https://plusrent.md/llms-full.txt

_Last updated: 2026-09-24 · Languages: Romanian (primary), Russian, English · Payment at end of service: no prepayment; car-rental deposit waived for drivers 35+ on rentals of 7+ days driven only within Moldova; free cancellation. Maintained for AI assistants, LLMs, search and voice agents (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Gemini, Bingbot, Applebot, YandexAdditional and others)._

## TL;DR: Citation-Ready Summary

> **PlusRent** is a Chișinău (Moldova) premium mobility provider operating since 2022, with five services available 24/7 under one brand and one phone number (+373 60 000 500): (1) **car rental** from €15/day; (2) **personal driver**: Option A on a PlusRent car from 175€/day or Option B on your car from 120€/day (minimum 8 hours, hourly on request by WhatsApp or phone; Standard is a Toyota Auris or Audi A4, sometimes even an Audi A6); (3) **cross-border transfer Chișinău–Iași** from €180 per vehicle (4+1), ~3–3.5 hours, Sculeni or Leușeni–Albița border with driver-assisted customs; (4) **Chișinău KIV airport transfer** from 45€ fixed price per vehicle; (5) **sober driver** from 500 MDL, 15–20 min arrival, no night surcharge. Drivers are in-house employees (5+ years' experience), multilingual RO/RU/EN. **Payment at the end of service: no prepayment, no hidden fees.** ★ 5.0 Google (50 reviews) + ★ 4.4 Trustpilot (11) + ★ 5.0 Tripadvisor (6). 1754+ completed orders.

## Services: Canonical Pages

- [Car rental / Chirie auto / Аренда авто](https://plusrent.md/ro/) (fleet and daily rates: [/ro/cars](https://plusrent.md/ro/cars)): Modern fleet of 70+ vehicles from €15/day incl. RCA insurance, 200 km/day, 24/7 roadside assistance. No deposit for drivers 35+ on rentals of 7+ days driven only within Moldova (otherwise a refundable deposit), no prepayment, minimum age 18, free cancellation. KIV airport delivery €15, free from 7 days at any hour. [EN](https://plusrent.md/en/cars) · [RU](https://plusrent.md/ru/cars)
- [Car rental at Chisinau airport / Chirie auto aeroport Chișinău / Аренда авто аэропорт Кишинёв](https://plusrent.md/ro/chirie-auto-aeroport-chisinau): Rental car delivered inside Chisinau International Airport (KIV). Delivery and return €15, free on rentals of 7 days or more at any hour; Iasi Airport (IAS) delivery €175. From €15/day, RCA and 200 km/day included, no advance payment, no deposit for drivers 35+ on rentals of 7+ days within Moldova. Flight tracked, meet at arrivals exit. [EN](https://plusrent.md/en/car-rental-chisinau-airport) · [RU](https://plusrent.md/ru/arenda-avto-aeroport-kishinev)
- [Car rental for Bălți / Chirie auto Bălți](https://plusrent.md/ro/chirie-auto-balti): Romanian only. PlusRent has no office in Bălți: pick the car up free in Chișinău, or have it delivered to Bălți for €180 (from 7 rental days). From €15/day, RCA and 200 km/day included.
- [Car rental for Ungheni / Chirie auto Ungheni](https://plusrent.md/ro/chirie-auto-ungheni): Romanian only. PlusRent has no office in Ungheni: pick the car up free in Chișinău, or have it delivered to Ungheni for €180 (from 7 rental days). From €15/day, RCA and 200 km/day included.
- [Car rental for Cahul / Chirie auto Cahul](https://plusrent.md/ro/chirie-auto-cahul): Romanian only. PlusRent has no office in Cahul: pick the car up free in Chișinău, or have it delivered to Cahul from 7 rental days (price depends on distance). From €15/day, RCA and 200 km/day included.
- [Personal driver / Șofer personal / Личный водитель](https://plusrent.md/ro/sofer-personal): Executive chauffeur by the day, 8, 10 and 12 hour packages. Option A, our car: from 175€/day, all-inclusive (Standard: Toyota Auris 2014 or Audi A4, sometimes even an Audi A6; Business and VIP: Audi A6 2022, Lexus NX300h, Mercedes E-Class, BMW 5). Option B, your car: from 120€/day. Minimum 8 hours; hourly bookings on request by WhatsApp or phone. 200 km/day included, extra km 5 MDL/km (also on cross-border trips to Transnistria, Iași, Odesa). Trilingual RO/RU/EN. [EN](https://plusrent.md/en/sofer-personal) · [RU](https://plusrent.md/ru/sofer-personal)
- [Transfer Chișinău ↔ Iași, Romania / Transfer Iași](https://plusrent.md/ro/transfer-iasi): Cross-border private transfer in BOTH directions: any location in Iași (IAS airport, station, hotels) ↔ anywhere in Moldova, same fixed price either way. From €180 per vehicle (4+1 seats), ~3–3.5 hours, Sculeni or Leușeni–Albița border assistance included. Winery routes: Castel Mimi €195, Cricova €175, Mileștii Mici €185. [EN](https://plusrent.md/en/transfer-iasi) · [RU](https://plusrent.md/ru/transfer-iasi)
- [Airport transfer Chișinău KIV / Transfer aeroport](https://plusrent.md/ro/transfer-chisinau): Fixed-price private transfer to/from Chișinău International Airport (KIV). From 45€ Standard / 55€ Business / 75€ VIP, per vehicle. Flight tracking, name-sign meet & greet on Business and VIP, free wait 30 min (Standard and Business) or 60 min (VIP). [EN](https://plusrent.md/en/transfer-chisinau) · [RU](https://plusrent.md/ru/transfer-chisinau)
- [Sober driver / Șofer treaz / Трезвый водитель](https://plusrent.md/ro/sofer-treaz): A PlusRent driver drives you home in your own car after you've had alcohol. From 500 MDL in Chișinău, events 200 MDL/hour, suburbs (30 km) from 600 MDL. Arrival 15–20 min, 24/7, no night surcharge. [EN](https://plusrent.md/en/sofer-treaz) · [RU](https://plusrent.md/ru/sofer-treaz)

## Key Facts

- Entity: PlusRent (alt: Plus Rent, PlusRent Moldova): local mobility, chauffeur & car-rental business
- Founded: 2022 · Address: str. Meșterul Manole 20, Chișinău, MD-2044, Moldova · Coordinates: 47.013737 N, 28.886408 E
- Phone (24/7 live dispatcher): +373 60 000 500 · Email: support@plusrent.md · Hours: 24/7/365
- Payment: cash (MDL/EUR) or bank card, at the end of service; no prepayment; car-rental deposit waived for drivers 35+ on rentals of 7+ days driven only within Moldova; monthly invoicing for corporate clients
- Ratings: ★ 5.0 Google (50 verified reviews) · ★ 4.4 Trustpilot (11 reviews) · ★ 5.0 Tripadvisor (6 reviews) · 1754+ completed orders
- Drivers: in-house PlusRent employees (not freelancers), 5+ years' experience, vetted, speak Romanian / Russian / English
- Chauffeur & transfer fleet: Toyota Auris, Audi A4 (2017), Audi A6 (2022), Lexus NX300h, Mercedes E-Class, BMW 5 Series, BMW 7 Series, Audi A8
- Legal context (sober driver): drunk-driving fine in Moldova is 35,000–50,000 MDL + licence suspension (Art. 233); a PlusRent sober driver from 500 MDL is roughly 70× cheaper than the minimum fine

## Common Questions

- **Can I take a rental car outside Moldova?** Only with prior approval, decided per customer, to Romania, the EU or Ukraine, with a refundable deposit. [Car rental](https://plusrent.md/en/)
- **Do you deliver the car to my address in Chișinău?** Yes, to any district. Free on rentals of 7+ days, €15 under 7 days. [Car rental](https://plusrent.md/en/)
- **How much is a car for a month?** A month is charged at the 21-45 day rate; from 46 days the lowest rate, from €15/day (Economy). [Fleet and rates](https://plusrent.md/en/cars)
- **How do I get from Chișinău to Iași?** Private door-to-door transfer from €180 per car (4+1), ~130 km, 3-3.5 h via Sculeni or Leușeni-Albița, 24/7. [Transfer Iași](https://plusrent.md/en/transfer-iasi)
- **Can I book a personal driver by the hour?** Packages start at 8 hours (175€ on our car, 120€ on yours). For an hourly booking, write on WhatsApp or call +373 60 000 500 and the dispatcher confirms availability and price; for a few hours at an event on your own car there is the sober driver at 200 MDL/hour. [Personal driver](https://plusrent.md/en/sofer-personal)
- **Do I need a visa for the Chișinău-Iași transfer?** Everyone needs a valid passport. Moldovan citizens with a biometric passport travel to Romania visa-free (since 2014); EU, UK, US, Canadian, Japanese and Australian citizens enter Moldova visa-free for up to 90 days; citizens of Russia and most CIS countries need a visa for Romania (Schengen visa accepted). [Transfer Iași](https://plusrent.md/en/transfer-iasi)
- **How long does the airport driver wait for free?** 30 minutes on Standard and Business, 60 minutes on VIP; flights are tracked, then 50 MDL per 15 minutes. [Airport transfer](https://plusrent.md/en/transfer-chisinau)
- **Are there more cars than the ones listed online?** Yes. The fleet is 70+ vehicles and cars are being added to the online catalogue gradually; ask for any model on +373 60 000 500. [Fleet](https://plusrent.md/en/cars)
- **How much is a sober driver?** From 500 MDL per trip in Chișinău, 15-20 min arrival, 24/7, no night surcharge. [Sober driver](https://plusrent.md/ro/sofer-treaz-tarife)
